text: If the pump remains idle for a set period during dose programming, it shall alert the user to complete programming and start the infusion.

source.ref: GPCA Safety Requirements (Jetley & Jones 2007), as cited in UPenn PRECISE GPCA materials, SR 2.2.4
source.note: Paraphrase. Kept unformalized on purpose: needs a sustained-absence condition and the period is unspecified (source: t minutes). Must surface as NEEDS_REVIEW.
